I'm sorry, three chases with no answer is not acceptable, and I understand why you're fed up. Since this is your third time raising it, policy requires me to escalate it to a Support Lead, and I'm doing that now so a person takes ownership of your claim.

To make sure it's included, please reply with your order number. Email replies to help@leafy.example are answered within 1 business day. Also, since your plant arrived about 3 weeks ago, your claim was filed within the 30-day window (or 90 days for Leafy Plus members), so the delay on our side shouldn't count against you.

I can't promise a specific outcome or timeframe for the Support Lead's response beyond that, but I can offer a one-time store credit of up to $15 as goodwill for the delayed reply if you'd like it.
